epi_source: frozen c2l mean Epithelial / sum all 30 modeled types
cnv_role: diagnostic annotation only; no externally validated baseline or transferable threshold
connectivity: six true lattice neighbors AND actual distance <=1.35*d_NN
mask_geometry: affine fitted hexagonal lattice Voronoi cells; no hull
holes: retain all; no smoothing or filling
bandwidth: per-section median nearest-neighbor distance in recorded image pixels
primary_exclusion: distance to any unsupported tissue/grid edge <=w; signed distance retained but not used in primary contrasts
distance: exact Euclidean point-to-segment distance, within tissue connected component; inner uses own region
far_tissue: only when distance to support edge >w
high_low: new section-relative Epi-anchor median; >median high, <median low, ==median tied_unclassified; not frozen original state
statistics: descriptive section paired contrasts; average repeated sections within verified patient; no spot-level inferential P
representatives: one per dataset, lexicographically first section with image, coordinates, composition; selected before response analysis
physical_area: not available; image-pixel grid area only
